run.title: Build & Run Mosaic
run.command: xcodebuild -project Mosaic.xcodeproj -scheme Mosaic -derivedDataPath build -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' build && (pkill -x Mosaic; open -n build/Build/Products/Debug/Mosaic.app --args -MosaicStorage /tmp/mosaic-dev)

agent_prompt: Mosaic is a native macOS menu bar app (no simulators or web runtime). Build and test with xcodebuild from app/Mosaic using the worktree-local -derivedDataPath build. Run dev builds with -MosaicStorage /tmp/mosaic-dev so your saved arrangements are left alone.
